Work under the assumptions of Lemma 4.3.
Use the valuated flag matroid correspondence identifying quotient relations with containment of tropical linear spaces.

The reversal in Claim 4.3.1 is precisely the equivalence
\[
   \Trop(p)\subseteq \Trop(q)
   \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
   \Trop(q^\perp)\subseteq \Trop(p^\perp).
\]
fixed_proof:
The valuated flag matroid correspondence says that
\[
   \Trop(p)\subseteq \Trop(q)
\]
if and only if \(q\twoheadrightarrow p\). Applying Claim 4.3.1 converts this quotient relation into \(p^\perp\twoheadrightarrow q^\perp\), which is equivalent to
\[
   \Trop(q^\perp)\subseteq \Trop(p^\perp).
\]
